conditions. Review procedures for navigating in dense fog.

items.title: Special Weather Statement issued May 27 at 6:48AM CDT by NWS Brownsville TX
items.summary:
At 647 AM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 10
miles southeast of El Cenizo, or 10 miles north of San Ygnacio,
moving northeast at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
San Ygnacio.

This includes US Highway 83 between mile markers 738 and 762.
